description: Patch the three confirmed review findings: use the correct main-repository HEAD during pre-land recovery, allocate collision-safe verification log files across CLI processes, and prevent a live factory owner from continuing after its lease is replaced. Add focused regression tests and run the full quality gate.

comments.text: Patched all three findings. Recovery now accepts baseline or already-landed HEAD only for an unreceipted detached-worktree landing; in-place recovery remains strict. Verification logs use exclusive cryptographic filenames with bounded collision retry. Stale leases check live local PIDs, and abandoned Erlang owners remove their lease. mix check passed: 154 normal tests, 2 subprocess tests, 79.84% coverage, production escript build and smoke test.

title: Fix workflow recovery safety defects
